cs.t: I actually use a LectroFan device _for_ noise cancelling. It's not a fan (originally it was) and I use the (Color)Noise sounds for the purpose but nonetheless. Also when traveling in Asia I always found the AC noise droning out the city noise to be a welcome side effect.

You can also assign it to the triple click shortcut in Accessibility. You probably can to the double/triple back taps too, though I haven’t tried. I do use a standalone Lectrofan for sleep as I prefer my noise machine to be across the room and Alexa-controlled (via a smart switch), plus it’s louder and the brown noise is “browner.” But I keep iOS BG sound mapped to the triple-click shortcut for when noise-cancelling just isn’t enough in loud restaurants etc. It works great with AirPods for reducing my noise sensitivity issues.
